narrative.overview: Tonight is a timetable, like the set-times board at a festival. Three rows (Manual, Show, Autopilot), a NOW line, flat blocks of colour with dark text. Made for a laptop in a dark room next to DJ decks, and for a touch screen. The eye finds the song that plays first, then the NOW line, then what is running. Everything else stays quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Flat colour, square corners, no gradients, glow or shadows
One colour per row (manual, show, autopilot), used for nothing else
Paper means now and the primary action

rules.name: The Row Colour Rule
rules.body: Pink, cyan and marigold mean Manual, Show and Autopilot. They never decorate, highlight or mark a primary action.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Paper fills mean now or this one. Text on a fill is always ink.

rules.name: The Red Rule
rules.body: Red is for blackout, recording and errors only. Recording is red while it is on.

rules.name: The 13 Rule
rules.body: Nothing read during a show is smaller than 13 px.

rules.name: The Tempo Rule
rules.body: The tempo is the largest text. Nothing else exceeds 26 px.

rules.name: The Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere. Capitals only for LIVE and NOW.

rules.name: The Release Rule
rules.body: What you touch on the Console stays yours until Release. A pad that is off but still held keeps a pink outline and a held tag.

rules.name: The No Shift Rule
rules.body: On the Console nothing moves when a look starts or stops: Running has a fixed height, its hold notice has a reserved line, lists scroll sideways.

dos: Do give a running thing the colour of its row as a solid fill, and the NOW flag.
Do use paper for the single primary action and for now.
Do say why a control is disabled, on the control.
Do narrow a label before shrinking it.
donts: Don't use pink, cyan or marigold for anything but manual, show and autopilot.
Don't add gradients, glow, shadows or rounded corners.
Don't set any text larger than the tempo.
